setEffects.twoPieceEffect:
Reduces Total DMG taken by the character by 20%, and increases the team's Crit DMG and Elemental DMG by 10% (exclusive).
Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer equip bonus:
● Enemies on the field take 7% more Physical DMG from her.
● Another Possibility increases Crit DMG and Elemental DMG by 30% when Wheel of Destiny is activated.
setEffects.threePieceEffect:
Increases Crit Rate by 7% and Crit DMG by 12%.
Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer equip bonus:
● Crit DMG increases by 12%.
● When Combo ATK or QTE hits or when entering Stellar Outburst, all teammates gain Another Possibility, which lasts for 25s. Retriggering refreshes the duration. Characters with Another Possibility deal 10% more Total DMG.
● When Astral Ring is not activated:
      ○ Crit DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG increase by 40%. Enemies on the field take 12% more Total DMG from Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer.
● When Wheel of Destiny is activated:
      ○ For every teammate protected by Wheel of Destiny, other members in the team deals 3% more Total DMG.
      ○ Characters with Another Possibility deal 30% more Elemental DMG and 25% more Physical DMG, and their ranged ATKs deal 9% more Total DMG.
      ○ When the user has Another Possibility:
            ◆ Enemies take 20% more Total DMG (exclusive).
            ◆ When the user is on the field, enemies on the field are impaired, decreasing their DEF by 55%.
